admission.justification: Durable discovery, immutable replay identity, FIFO partition choice and bounded rotating receipt walks jointly preserve deliverability through interruption; no one member alone promises that ordered recovery under the host size limit.

guarantee: An admitted native held FIFO batch remains discoverable across receipt-counter and delivery-record interruptions, retains immutable replay identities, and reaches the host in the fewest complete-message parts under its stable size limit, without building a whole-fleet receipt-path census.
title: Native held delivery preserves order through recovery and bounded rotation
